title: State relabeling commutes with oracle runs
statement: Let $k\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\Sigma$ be an alphabet, let $S,S'$ be state sets, let $x$ be a word over $\Sigma$, let $M$ be an oracle Turing machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes and states $S$, and let $e\colon S\simeq S'$ be a bijection. For every oracle language $O$ over $\Sigma$, configuration $c$ on input $x$, and $t\in\mathbb{N}$, running the relabeled machine for $t$ steps from the configuration obtained by relabeling $c$ gives the configuration obtained by relabeling the result of running $M$ from $c$ for $t$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is an oracle Turing machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes and states $S$
